_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process, including pull requests, is described in https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: govulncheck checks the code against the Go vulnerability database in CI and fails the job when it reports a vulnerability the code actually reaches, so each such finding has to be fixed or assessed before a change passes: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml (shared workflow: https://github.com/netresearch/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/go-check.yml).
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under MIT, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The licence is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/LICENSE
release_notes_justification: Human-readable release notes per version are kept in https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md; it covers the latest release, v1.0.1.
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/issues
sites_https_justification: Every project site is served over HTTPS: the repository and its release downloads, https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia.
static_analysis_justification: golangci-lint runs on every pull request to `main` through https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared Go check where golangci-lint is on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/go-check.yml). Configuration: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/.golangci.yml.
test_justification: The repository carries 298 Go test files (*_test.go) in https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia. CI runs them on every pull request to `main` through https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared Go check where `go test` runs by default (https://github.com/netresearch/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/go-check.yml).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs the test suite on every pull request to `main`: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared Go check where `go test` runs by default (https://github.com/netresearch/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/go-check.yml).
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning, for example v1.0.1: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/tags
version_tags_justification: Every release is tagged in git: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/tags
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version number, recorded as a git tag, for example v1.0.1: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/tags
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled and described in https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/SECURITY.md: https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in https://github.com/netresearch/ofelia/blob/main/SECURITY.md
